items.label: Large Capicaty Water Bottle Organizer
items.value: We have increased the spacing between each grid compartment up to 5.59", which is very suitable for some large water bottles or cups up to 40 OZ. For Example - for YETI Brand or STANLEY Brand 30/40 oz insulated tumbler; for Nalgenes Brand 32 oz wide mouth water bottle; for Hydro Flask Brand 32 oz/40 oz wide mouth bottle, etc. The size of this water bottle organizer for cabinet: 7.82" x 13.19" x 12.21"

items.label: Stackable Design
items.value: This water bottle organizer for stanley cup accessories features a stackable design, with each layer holding up to 3 bottles and a total of 9 bottles for 3 layers. It can be easily split and combined to suit your needs. The slot design allows for easy installation of the water bottle rack. Simply align the slots and buckle them together to stack and make efficient use of vertical space

items.label: Space Saving
items.value: The water bottle organizer for cabinet can be stacked according to your needs, providing an easy solution for organizing the surplus water bottles in your home, maximizing your space savings. It is easy to stack and can be freely split and combined. Installation is simple and requires no tools, with assembly completed in just 1 minute

items.label: Versatile Home Storage and Organization
items.value: The versatile water bottle holder can be used in kitchens, wine cellars, restaurants, bars, cabinets, tea rooms, countertops and other places to store various types of water bottles, helping to eliminate clutter. The bottle rack can also be used to store wine, soda cans, champagne, juice drinks, cans, toiletries, bottled condiments, wine displays and more

items.label: High Quality
items.value: This water bottle storage rack is made of clear BPA free shatter-resistant plastic and shatterproof PET material, which is waterproof, and sturdy and durable. It has excellent load-bearing capacity and can hold up to 40 ounce bottles
